newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP Steel despatches up, output down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP Steel despatches up, output down.

text.p: Australia's biggest raw steel maker, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP), reported on Tuesday a four percent fall in production for the first half to November 30, but offshore demand boosted total despatches by six percent.
Output fell due to planned maintenance at a blast furnace at Port Kembla, continued work on a furnace reline at Newcastle and operational difficulties at the Whyalla plant, BHP said.
Domestic desptaches in Australia and New Zealand were flat for the first six months compared with the 1995/96 first half.
But despatches from other international operations and exports of semi-finished product from Australia and New Zealand helped lift the group's overall level of despatches, it said.
